visual-pr.description: Write the pull request description for the current change so a reviewer understands why it exists and its shape, with screenshots or recordings when the change is visual.

no-comments.description: Remove redundant narrating code comments an agent left in a diff, keeping only comments that state non-obvious constraints.

benchmark-checklist.description: Vet a performance measurement before reporting it: score a before-and-after benchmark, speedup or regression claim against a checklist of limiter, repeatability and relevance.

why.description: Explain why the code or a past design decision is the way it is: design rationale, regressions, postmortems and the evidence behind choices.

interrogate.description: Ask hard adversarial questions one at a time to challenge a plan or change from independent angles and find blind spots before building.

architect.description: Sketch types, signatures and module boundaries before writing code, deciding where ownership of state and module structure should sit.

tdd.description: Implement a feature test-first: write a failing test, make it pass, refactor; also write a regression test for a bug.

make-bot-ui.description: Build a custom page or dashboard with buttons that triggers a bot through a webhook.

poteto-mode.description: Work in poteto's concise, verified agent style with deliberate subagents and unslopped prose.
